mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REPORT ( REPORT_ID, MEM_ID, BOARD_ID, COMENT_ID, REPORT_CONTENT, REPORT_DATE )VALUES( 'R'||REPORT_SEQ.NEXTVAL, (SELECT MEM_ID FROM MEMBER WHERE MEM_LOGIN_ID = #{memReporter}), #{boardId}, #{comentId}, #{reportContent}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT C.MEM_LOGIN_ID, A.REPORT_CONTENT, A.ACTION_DATE, A.ENDACTION_DATE, CASE WHEN A.ENDACTION_DATE >= SYSDATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS BEEN_COUNT FROM REPORT A INNER JOIN BOARD B ON (A.BOARD_ID = B.BOARD_ID) INNER JOIN MEMBER C ON (B.MEM_ID = C.MEM_ID) WHERE C.MEM_LOGIN_ID = #{memLoginId}
ORDER BY A.ENDACTION_DATE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
